newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ Tourism Board to develop Internet web site.
newsitem.headline: NZ Tourism Board to develop Internet web site.

text.p: The New Zealand Tourism Board announced on Tuesday that it would develop an Internet web site to act as a gateway for the New Zealand tourism industry.

Branded "Passport to New Zealand", the web site would contain general information about New Zealand as a tourist destination such as suggested itineraries, entry requirements, accommodation and activity details, as well as provide links to existing tourism and travel-related sites.
The board said it would promote the site through its 16 offshore offices and in marketing materials including one million copies of a holiday planning brochure.
December had been chosen as the launch date with the summer tourist season in mind. -- Wellington Newsroom (64 4) 4734746
